# Related Links

# Checklist

All items are required unless otherwise stated.

- [ ] I have read and comprehend the [CONTRIBUTING] guidelines.
- [ ] I have read and comprehend the [genAI/LLM Policy].
- [ ] This pull request has been [vouched](https://github.com/gpui-ce/gpui-ce/discussions/categories/vouch-request). If not, this PR may be closed due our limited resources and need to prioritize how we spend them.
- [ ] I have updated the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/gpui-ce/gpui-ce/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). Leave unchecked if you feel the changelog does not need updating (e.g. doesn't affect external API, doesn't fix a bug, and doesn't meaningfully change functionality - like adding examples).
- [ ] I have added or updated any documentation as needed to support the changes in this PR.
- [ ] I have added unit tests as needed (if any new functionality has been added).

You must check one of:

- [ ] No generative AI (including LLMs) tools were used to create this PR.
- [ ] I used LLMs to write code or other text (either in the commits or in this pull request description).

[genAI/LLM Policy]: https://github.com/gpui-ce/gpui-ce/blob/main/AI_POLICY.md
